notes: PRODUCTION TU: the verified 44-function object replaces the former 42-function class object and the two adjacent MgTrampolineTime factory/element sources, while also owning the contiguous class data band.

The complete 44-function Bounce & Pounce scene run is reconstructed as one dScMgTrampoline_c C++ translation unit: the 42-function class run, adjacent MgTrampolineTime_Spawn classInit, and its immediately following 0x24-byte element constructor. The next function begins dScMgTrampoline2_c, closing the right boundary.

Four C-derived two-word camera-pair copies initially scalarised differently in C++ mode. Copying through P2Words, whose only member is an int[2], preserves the original front end's blind aggregate-copy scheduling and makes all four byte-exact without changing their data model.

FACTORY RELOCATION PROOF: because the consolidated TU owns _ZTV17dScMgTrampoline_c, MgTrampolineTime_Spawn must select the Itanium ABI address point with +2 int words. The legacy standalone source used addend zero against an external symbol; objisolate correctly rejected that spelling once the vtable became local.

LIFECYCLE ORDER PROOF: the one real inline virtual destructor in dScMgTrampoline_c.h makes mwccarm emit retail D1 then D0 in cartridge order without an extra D2 body; the factory and destructor agree on all three member arrays.

LINKAGE PROOF: partial-link contribution comparison caught two declarations accidentally lifted out of the legacy extern-C block in OnYoshiTryEat. Restoring C linkage for _ZN3G2x13SetBlendAlphaEPVttttj and func_ov006_020d0b04 yields 44/44 contribution-equivalent derived objects and zero unhomed imports.

NON-TEXT BOUNDARY: the contiguous 0x0213faa0..0x0213fbc4 band contains six state/profile records, this class's compiler-generated RTTI/vtable, and three resource tables. Its final byte is exactly the start of dScMgTrampoline2_c's verified data band; no BSS or initializer is claimed.

STATE-MEMBER PROOF: the five address-only callbacks at 0x02121774, 0x02121778, 0x02121848, 0x021218fc and 0x02121d64 are real no-argument dScMgTrampoline_c members. Behavior dispatches an eight-byte member pointer from this+0x5004, and the TU's five adjacent eight-byte descriptors relocate to exactly those bodies. Each compiler-spelled member is byte-exact. The StateDone/StateWaitExit/StateResults/StatePlay/StateIntro suffixes are behavioral coinage, disclosed in symbols/actor_renames.tsv.

STATE-ENTRY HELPER PROOF: the adjacent address-only helpers at 0x021218c4, 0x02121cf4 and 0x02121f04 initialize the results, play and intro fields respectively, then copy the matching TU-owned PMF descriptor into this+0x5004. Their BeginResults/BeginPlay/BeginIntro spellings are behavioral coinage, disclosed in the header, notes/minigame-provenance.md and symbols/actor_renames.tsv.

PER-FRAME HELPER PROOF: Behavior's sole call to 0x0212157c samples and tracks the stylus drag and records its release edge, while StatePlay's sole call to 0x02121bc8 derives the BG scroll target from score progress and approaches it. Both now compile as genuine dScMgTrampoline_c members named UpdateTouchInput and UpdateScroll; the spellings are behavioral coinage disclosed in the header, provenance note and rename ledger.

PMF STATIC-INITIALIZER WALL: spelling the five namespace-scope descriptors directly as dScMgTrampoline_c::State initializers makes mwccarm 2004/b56 emit a new __sinit, .ctor entry and five anonymous data temporaries absent from the cartridge. The class declares the State type and Behavior uses it at dispatch; the runtime field and ROM descriptors retain raw two-word storage, with literal aliases used only to give the descriptors relocations to the compiler-spelled member symbols.
